t: Getting Mac NeoVim Same as NixOS NeoVim
s: This article details the process of achieving a consistent NeoVim environment across macOS and NixOS using Nix flakes, focusing on aligning development workflows and configurations.
sub: Synchronizing NeoVim configuration (`init.lua`) between NixOS and macOS via Nix flakes.
Leveraging `nix develop` to create reproducible development shells with consistent tools.
Troubleshooting visual differences in NeoVim spell checking (squiggles vs. underlines) by aligning `nixpkgs` versions.
Adapting Mac workflows (virtual desktops, function keys) to maintain productivity and muscle memory.
Integrating AI tools like Cursor AI into daily workflows for code assistance and cross-platform refinement.
